name: AI Messenger Video
description: Audio and video calling plugin for AI Messenger.

settings.help_text: The URL for the self-hosted video server. For this deployment, use the AI Messenger Jitsi endpoint.
When true, video calls open as a floating window inside Mattermost by default. Users can override this setting with '/videocall settings'.
When false, the pre-join page will not be displayed for embedded video calls.
Select how video call names are generated by default. Users can override this setting with '/videocall settings'.

options.display_name: Random English words in title case (e.g. PlayfulDragonsObserveCuriously)
Mattermost context specific names. Combination of team name, channel name, and random text in Public and Private channels; personal video call name in Direct and Group Message channels.
Allow user to select video call name

settings.display_name: Use JWT authentication for video calls:
settings.help_text: Optional. If the video server uses JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for authentication, set this value to true.
Optional. The app ID used for authentication by the video server and JWT token generator.
Optional. The app secret used for authentication by the video server and JWT token generator.
Optional. The number of minutes from when the video call link is created to when it becomes invalid. Minimum is 1 minute. Only applies if JWT authentication is enabled.

Insecure. If the video server is not compatible with this plugin, include the JavaScript API hosted on that server directly in Mattermost instead of the default API version provided by the plugin. Use with caution.
